scope: Post-cleanup working-copy verification. The separate fresh Conda installation is recorded in fresh-install.json.
input_source: The standalone locomotor_learning_model-DATA folder, prepared into an empty destination; no author source packages required.

inputs.purpose: Cached numerical reproduction of the submitted publication; not a raw simulation rerun
caveats: Original and regenerated realizations are retained separately.
Reference tables may describe earlier analyses; use per-figure exported tables for plotted data.
No regenerated S3 rollout subset is synthesized or inferred from fitted parameters.
Supplied COSMED recordings and OpenSim source outputs are retained; available optimization conditions do not by themselves establish a complete optimization rerun.

table_comparison.interpretation: Only floating-point rounding differences; agreement is well within reported precision.

simulations.data_example_checkpoint: Resumed from the standalone DATA folder to 20 iterations
simulations.matlab_step_configuration: Both baseline helpers passed actual MATLAB checks for requested step counts 2, 3 and 4; 3 normalizes to 4 before iteration budgeting.

data_refresh: Only the standalone README and its checksum index changed relative to the earlier verified ZIP. All 103 scientific/supporting payload files are byte-identical.
limits: Full original stochastic sweeps, raw-recording preprocessing and original OpenSim optimization were not rerun.
This does not establish anonymous Zenodo download availability.
